title: Peace, Neither Ink nor Blood
coreMove: Judge peace by the structure of consequence that keeps it alive after the ink dries.
sourcePressure: Declared peace is weak unless the arrangement gives each side a credible reason not to break it.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Making the chapter generic diplomacy advice or glorifying force.

sourceAnchors.name: Peace, Neither Ink nor Blood
sourceAnchors.detail: The sidecar supports declared peace versus durable peace, with stability coming from credible consequence rather than words alone.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The title should push the writer to ask what holds when signatures stop being fresh and nobody is bleeding today.
